description: Check whether candidate signal criteria match enough stores (80 or more). Returns {"enough": true|false}. It does not save anything. Paid plans only.

criteria.description: Either {"root": node} with a recursive tree, or the flat form {"signalIds": [...], "legacyCategories": [...], "icpFilters": [...]}. A node is {"type":"group","op":"AND"|"OR","children":[...]}, {"type":"not","child":node}, {"type":"signal","signalId":"..."}, {"type":"legacyCategory","category":"..."} or {"type":"icp","column":"...","operator":"...","value":"..."}. Use the catalog and ICP columns from listSignalSets.

setId.description: Optional. The id of a set you are editing.
